purpose: Repair measured orbital-phase insertion under unchanged physical parameters. Three registered first-burn controls; no fitting, AI, downstream mission or authority.

fixed_control_law.coast: Geocentric measured orbital-plane tangent prealignment; main0.
fixed_control_law.restart: Bound orbit with apoapsis>=finalperigee+existing50kmheadroom; inbound vr in[-20,0]m/s and apogee-radius<=2km; attitude<=5deg; bodyrate<=.02rad/s; positive targetellipse tangential velocityerror; first main available; fuel>75t; clock<4000s.
fixed_control_law.insertion: Same geocentric measured tangent; 1 first main at existing min_throttle(.4). No275km altitude servo, no insertion pitch offset.
fixed_control_law.target_ellipse: Perigee220km and apoapsis=current radius, used for restart diagnostic only; no stateassignment/predictedfeasibility.
fixed_control_law.stop: Measured bound perigee>=220km: request main0 and integrate actual spool/attitude for5s. Maximum burn60s, no repeatignition.
fixed_control_law.first_burn: Same laws, offsets, limits and settings as corresponding saved parent; all new actions begin after firstcutoff.

comparison.prefix: Bind exact parent compressed/raw hashes. Require full available actual state/command prefix through firstcutoff. Compare full step records where parent has them; legacy B0 supports sparse/witness prefix only.
comparison.old_experiments: v4 consumed; D11 unexecuted; no priorrecord/metric/threshold rewritten.
comparison.outcome: Report every validphysicalnegative; no winnerselection; all3pass supports3 engineering initial paths only.
comparison.fidelity: Existing referencev3 altitude/speed3km/150m/s/20% gates separate; new insertion cannot claim fixing ascentfit.

fit_data.missing_values: Use every frozen finite nonblank observation except the same eleven wrong-body altitude fields. Only four individually sourced manual speed observations differ from original processedOCR. No filling, extra smoothing, retiming, extrapolation or residual-dependent masks.
fit_data.interpolation: Linear simulation interpolation at each observed elapsed time using finite bracketing samples no more than2.1 seconds apart; no extrapolation.
fit_data.coverage_rule: Complete0..491 coverage of both frozen masks is required for scoring. A valid physical failure before completing this fit coverage is inadmissible and preserved; a later physical insertion failure is reported separately and does not remove an otherwise valid fit candidate. An unexplained numerical/serialization/coverage defect is invalid and stops the cohort.

metrics.series_rmse: Partition elapsed times into half-open five-second bins[5k,5k+5); mean squared residual within each nonempty bin, then square root of the equally weighted bin means. Score altitude and speed with separate frozen masks.
metrics.baseline_gate: N0 is a new explicit-policy engineering control, not a byte-identical whole-record replay. Each case must match its exact saved parent physical/command prefix through first cutoff; available full trace is checked for L0/T0 and sparse actual observations/witnesses for N0. Numerical fit ratios use fresh N0 only.
metrics.selection: No automatic selection or winner. Report N0/L0/T0 insertion and all four unchanged fidelity gates separately; no downstream or mission admission.
metrics.report_all: Preserve every case actual orbit/attitude/restart/cutoff/spool-tail/fuel, full trace/independent record check and registered parent prefix. Report 0..491 masks/RMSE against fresh N0 separately; do not rescore or replace parent records.
metrics.fit_admissibility: Judge the frozen0..491 fit independently of later physical insertion outcomes: complete finite fit coverage plus valid separation/limits/state continuity is required. A physical failure after completing the fit window cannot trigger re-ranking or substitution; preserve its distinct downstream failure.

stop: Source/input/environment drift, prefix mismatch, numerical/record/serialization failure, wall/output/disk limit => stop cohort, preserve all output, no retry/resume. Validphysicalnegatives are results and do not restart any case.
permission: Direct user yes to state-based insertion repair; physical-only3cases within registered caps; providers0; no public push/merge/develop/certificate.

retention.plan: Keep original records unchanged. Commit only reviewed small evidence. After writer/child exit, archive with full hashes/metadata, verify every member, actually restore plan and representative raw record. No deletions or Docker/worktree changes in this cohort.
